strings.patient_templates.preop.graphic_preop.de: “That is the outline. Is there anything you still do not understand?”
“It sounds frightening, but everyone follows the sequence. Nothing is done at random.”
“Just remember: the more tense you become, the harder you make it on yourself.”
“Do you truly want the details? Then I will start at the beginning. Knowing the sequence is better than imagining it alone.”
strings.patient_templates.preop.graphic_preop.fa: “I am starting to think I do not want to go to the operating room.”

“If pain makes you dodge, curl up, or try to sit up, do not worry. The restraints keep those reflexes from disrupting the field. Once the operation begins, they probably will not be the worst sensation anymore.”
“What kind of reassurance is that?”
“Why does ‘accustomed’ sound so frightening?”
“That sounds completely contrary to instinct.”
“I think I regret understanding it now.”
“If we really decide on no anesthesia... what is opening the abdomen like? It is not one stab and then ripping me open like an animal, is it?”
“After the wall comes the peritoneum. Opening it can feel suddenly sharp, cold, and hollow, as though a sealed space has been opened.”
“A few patients lose bladder or bowel control from the pain. That is why your bowel is prepared and a catheter is placed. Even if it happens, the field will not become a complete mess.”
“Then come the retractors. It is not another incision. It is the open wound being held apart continuously. Once they settle, your body gradually becomes accustomed to the pull.”
“Nothing like that. First comes the skin. It is sensitive, so the first incision is often the worst. Then comes the fat, which is separated gradually rather than stirred around with a blade.”
“Below that are the fascia and abdominal wall. Do not lock your abdomen when it hurts. A rigid wall is harder to separate and makes the traction hurt you more.”
“That is not the part I am worried about!”
“I had not even imagined you might cut it off!”

“Pain may make you hunch your shoulder, guard your chest, or pull in your arm. Your arms are positioned and secured for that reason. You may embrace yourself in your mind; your hands should not grab the retractors.”
“They suddenly look especially precious while I am still dressed.”
“I think I regret understanding it now.”
“With the skin taut, the first incision is cleaner. Under the skin is fat, then glandular tissue. A deep lesion may require dissection down to the surface of the chest muscle.”
“The nipple area is sensitive, so we avoid it when possible. Drapes, retractors, or repositioned instruments may still touch it. Say so if it becomes intolerable.”
“You will not think I am overreacting?”
“How do you operate on a breast? You are not going to turn the whole thing inside out, are you?”
“Please do not point.”
“Not the whole breast. Once you are lying down, the assistant moves the soft tissue away from the incision, supports what needs supporting, and stretches the skin flat.”
“No. An awake patient will react during breast surgery. Besides, this operation is not aimed at removing the nipple.”
“Retractors hold the incision open. The sensation shifts from a sharp surface pain to the whole area being pulled, pressed, and separated. If the opening must widen, it is done gradually.”
“The bladder lies in front of the uterus, so we catheterize you and let it flatten out of the way. Bowel up, bladder flat, and the uterus becomes easier to expose.”
“I will feel my bowel being moved away?”
“If you are awake, you may feel something inside being pushed aside. Nausea the first time is normal.”
“I am seriously considering running out of the hospital.”
“Yes.”
“That explanation makes it even more embarrassing.”
“To us, it is simply the operative field. After the abdomen is opened, the first obstacle is often not the uterus but the bowel in front of it. It must be moved upward to clear the pelvis.”
“When we ask you to relax, try to relax: do not clamp your legs, brace your abdomen, or twist your waist. The more you guard yourself, the harder the field is to arrange.”
“Why did you close off my escape route immediately?”
“If the uterus still lies too deep, an instrument may be inserted from below to lift it. Without anesthesia, that can feel sore, full, and as though something is pushing upward from inside.”
“For gynecologic surgery... will I be put in that very embarrassing position?”
“Your legs are placed separately and secured, and the surgeon stands between them. That gives the best view and allows both the incision and preparation from below.”
“The bowel is prepared and a catheter placed. If pain, nausea, and traction arrive together, loss of control still will not contaminate the field.”
“Please do not smile while saying that everything is going according to plan.”
“You answered much too quickly.”
“Contamination is not what I am worried about!”
“Once exposure is good, the inside is very clear. And after you are secured, you need not worry about suddenly sitting up—it is basically impossible.”
“General anesthesia may be humanity’s greatest invention.”
“Why is everyone so casual about saying ‘tighten the restraints’?”
“That keeps the blade from sinking into chest fat and dragging back and forth. After skin and fat, the surface of the sternum is exposed.”
“If you truly cannot keep still, the restraints can be tightened. That part is comparatively easy to solve.”
“I truly do not want to enter the operating room now.”
“What does opening the chest actually mean? You are not truly cutting all the way down the middle, are you?”

“The approach is through the midline. Once you are flat, the shoulders and chest are aligned. If breast tissue covers the center, the assistant moves it aside so the skin becomes taut and the blade can travel straight.”

“Once open, the sensation becomes pressure pulling the whole rib cage apart. The body wants to curl inward, but the instruments are already positioned, so you must remain flat, breathe, and avoid lifting a shoulder.”
“After the sternum is divided, a chest retractor is placed between the edges and opened one notch at a time. You may hear it click until the surgeon can see inside.”
“Did you just say ‘saw’?”
“Then a dedicated sternal saw is used. There is sound, and some patients feel the vibration travel from the chest toward the shoulders and jaw.”
“Thank you for telling me... I suppose.”
“You are describing my chest as though it were a toolbox being opened.”
“Why do you think ‘it will not sink in’ reassures me?”

Pause and check how she feels

“You are doing it yourself, Doctor?” She moves aside with a smile. “All right, I will assist.”

strings.patient_bundles.patient_tifa.patient.rea: "I have to be hospitalized... Yeah, I understand. Then I have to make arrangements in the store first."
"Wait a minute, Dr. Sakaguchi. The surgery I'm talking about now is different from what I just explained, right? Can you tell me what's going on?"
"Yes, I understand. Just tell me how you need my cooperation next."
"Don't worry, I'm fine...well, actually I'm still a little nervous."
"General anesthesia... To be honest, I am still a little uneasy thinking that I will completely lose consciousness."
"That means I'll be awake the whole time, right? OK, I'll try to stay still."
"No anesthesia...? I know I can tolerate the pain, but surgery and fighting are completely different things, right...?"
"Well... then it's up to you, Dr. Sakaguchi. I can only trust you this time."
"Wait, wait! I know I just said I would persist, but if I really do surgery without anesthesia, I... I'm not sure!"
"I know I can't move! But that moment just now...ah, it hurts so much...! I will try my best, don't let me go...!"
"Ugh...! I feel it...it's not very painful, but it's really starting to cut, right...?"
"Ah——!! Wait, wait! It hurts...! No, this is completely different from being injured... It hurts inside...!"
"Thank you...just let me take it easy. I will continue to cooperate."
"Well... I won't move. You guys go ahead... I can hold on."
"Ugh...! Doctor, what happened just now... at least tell me where you are now...!"
"Well, I'm listening. Knowing what you are doing makes me feel more at ease."
"Doctor...? Why didn't you say anything all of a sudden? Is there something wrong...?"
"The hardest part is over...? It's great...I thought I really couldn't hold on anymore."
"Um...breathe slowly, right? Okay, I'll listen to you."
"It should be over soon...? Doctor, can you tell me...?"
"Enema...well, I understand it's pre-operative preparation. But...does this also have to be done?"
"Wait a minute... you want me to turn around? Okay... ok... I didn't expect that I would have to ask someone else to help me with this kind of thing..."
"Hey...isn't this step actually necessary? Then, why did you just..."
"It turns out you don't have to do it... Huh... I'm really a little embarrassed."
"Do I need to prepare skins here too...? Well, okay. But...can you prepare me mentally first?"
"Wait a minute...even the lower position has to be dealt with...I understand, and I will stay still."
"Can you just put all your hair in? My hair is quite long. Do you need my help?"
"That's it... Even the hair has to be completely covered. It feels like the surgery is really about to begin..."
"The arms need to be fixed here...Okay, I won't move. It feels a little weird just lying like this."
"Do you want to maintain this position until the end of the operation? Well... I will try my best to cooperate."
"Wait, wait... I haven't been anesthetized yet, do you have to immobilize me like this...? Do you really want to operate like this...?"
"I know I can't move...but it really hurts later, and I don't know if I can control my body...!"
"Where should the catheter... be put in...? I understand. I'm just a little embarrassed..."
"Yeah... I'll cooperate. But first, can you tell me how it will feel?"
"Wait a minute... Do you have to insert the catheter when you are fully awake? I-I'm not ready yet...!"
"Ah...! This feeling... ugh... I'm sorry, I didn't mean to tense up...!"
"It's so cold...! Wait a minute, are you going to start incision after disinfection...?"
"I'm already at the place where I'm going to operate...I know, but my heartbeat suddenly became so fast..."
"This line... is the place where we will cut it later, right?... I really have to be awake to watch you do the surgery..."
"So this is it... I never thought about this when I was injured, but now I'm really scared when I look at this line..."
strings.patient_bundles.patient_tifa.patient.out: I haven't had any serious discomfort recently, I just wanted to check my physical condition.
Please tell me everything that requires my cooperation.
If I need to be hospitalized, I have to make arrangements in the store first.
I am usually in good health and have never heard of drug allergies.
strings.patient_bundles.patient_tifa.encounter.f: "Do you need to take off your underwear for a basic physical examination...? Okay, let me first listen to your explanation of the scope of the examination."
"I understand, let's not do this part now. Thank you for respecting my choice."
"If this is a unified rule...I will cooperate." She tried to maintain her composure and completed preparations for the inspection.
"Okay. Please tell me step by step what needs to be done." She took off her clothes according to the instructions, crossed her arms and waited for inspection.
"Please don't force me with your treatment qualifications...I understand." She completed the examination in silence, trying to keep her breathing steady.

strings.patient_bundles.patient_emi_koda.patient: Emi Koda
Um… I suddenly fainted at work, and I haven't felt quite right since.
I'll try to explain clearly… Please let me know if I'm not explaining it well enough.
And… I don't want this to cause trouble for my colleagues or our customers.
I don't usually have any serious illnesses, and I'm not aware of any drug allergies.
"Hospitalization… I see. May I ask how much time I'll need to take off…? I don't want to cause the company any more trouble."
"All right, I understand… I'm supposed to be the one looking after others, but now so many people are looking after me. I feel terribly sorry about that."
"P-please wait, Dr. Sakaguchi… That doesn't seem to be the same surgical site you explained to me earlier… Has there been a mistake?"
"Thank you for explaining everything so carefully… Um, please tell me directly whenever you need my cooperation. I'll do my best."
"I'll do my best to cooperate… But if I get too nervous, please don't think I'm being difficult…"
"With general anesthesia… at least I won't embarrass myself in front of everyone, will I…?"
"I understand… If I can't stop trembling, please tell me what to do. I'm not trying to be uncooperative."
"I'm sorry… Does no anesthesia mean I'll be awake and feel you making the incision…? Is that right?"
"Thank you, Dr. Sakaguchi… I'll try to relax. I hope I won't cause everyone any more trouble once I'm asleep…"
"N-no…! I'm sorry, I know everyone's already prepared, but… I really can't face being cut like this…!"
"Aah—!! It hurts—it hurts so much! W-wait…! I'm sorry, I-I couldn't help crying out… Ah!"
"Yes… I'll try not to move. B-but my hands keep shaking… Please don't misunderstand; I really am trying…"
"A-are we past the hardest part already…? Thank you… I must have made such a scene just now…"
"An e-enema… Are you going to do it here? I'm sorry… I-I'm not quite sure what to do…"
"U-um… May I ask, will the nurse stay beside me the whole time…? I've never had this kind of preparation done in front of anyone before…"
"Oh… So it wasn't actually necessary…? Then, what I just… That was really embarrassing…"
"I-it's all right not to have an enema…? I understand… I'm sorry I was so nervous just now…"
"Skin preparation… Does that mean shaving the hair there too…? I'm sorry, I'm not trying to get in the way of the preparations…"
"I have to uncover this part too…? I-I know it's needed for surgery, but… Please give me a moment…"
"If it isn't necessary… Could I skip it for now? I'll cooperate with the preparations that are actually needed."
"I'm sorry, I know this is your job… It's just that thinking about having it done here still makes me a little nervous."
"The cap… Thank you. Now I really do look like a patient who's about to have surgery…"
"I just need to tuck all my hair inside…? All right… I normally take such care with my appearance at work. Things are completely different now…"
"This position… Do I have to stay like this for a long time? I-I'll try to do as you ask…"
"I'm sorry, I'm a little nervous… I used to remind customers to keep their footing, and now I'm not even sure how I'm supposed to lie down…"
"W-wait… You're going to secure me like this before I've had any anesthesia…? I'll try not to move, but I'm already trembling…"
"P-please wait… If it really hurts when you make the incision, will I be able to stay in this position the whole time…?"
"The urinary catheter… Does it go in through there…? I understand it's necessary, but… I'm really embarrassed…"
"I'll cooperate… But could you please not keep looking at me…? I'm sorry, I know you're doing your job…"
"W-wait…! Are you really going to insert the urinary catheter while I'm completely awake…? I-I'm so scared…!"
"Ah…! P-please be gentle… I know I shouldn't move, but this feeling… I really can't pretend I'm all right…!"
"The line you're drawing now… Is that where you're going to cut without anesthesia…? A-are we really going to start like this…?"
"Wait… Let me look at it once more… Are you about to cut here? I-I'm not ready yet…!"
strings.patient_bundles.patient_emi_koda.encount: "Do I need to take off my underwear too for the basic physical examination…? I'm sorry, I just want to confirm what it involves first."
"I understand. Then we'll leave that part for now. Thank you for respecting my choice."
"If that's the standard requirement… I'll cooperate." She tries to maintain a composed posture, but cannot bring herself to look up at the medical staff's faces.
"All right. Please tell me what I need to do, one step at a time." She follows the instructions, removes her clothes, and folds her arms around herself while waiting for the examination.
"Please don't use my access to treatment to pressure me… I understand." She goes through the examination in silence, barely able to maintain her polite expression.

strings.patient_bundles.patient_aerith.patient.o: Mm, let me explain the most noticeable symptoms: {line}
There's one more thing I should tell you: {line}
I spent some time in a Shinra research facility when I was little… So sometimes I ask a lot of questions. Don't mind me; I'm not trying to be difficult.
strings.patient_bundles.patient_aerith.encounter: “Oh, I need to take off all my clothes for this examination? …All right. But Doctor, can you first tell me where you'll be examining? I'm still awake, you know.”
“Oh, we're skipping this examination? …Whew, then I won't have to take off all my clothes. But have you really checked everything you need to?”
“…All right, I'll cooperate with the examination. But Doctor, don't just give orders. I'll still ask if there's something I don't understand.”
“Thank you for explaining first. Mm, I'll cooperate… Though having to take off all my clothes really is a little embarrassing.”
“…Don't use that tone with me. People have ordered me around like that before. Doctor, I know I need an examination, but I'm not some voiceless test subject.”
strings.patient_bundles.patient_aerith.preop.sta: “You're arranging the surgery today? …Hehe, don't let my smile fool you. I really am a little nervous.”
You will be the lead surgeon for this operation. Confirm the assignments for the assistant surgeon, scrub nurse, and circulating nurse.

“All the preparations are done? …Mm, I haven't made a last-minute escape. But remember to tell me what comes next.”
You and the surgical team finish changing and scrubbing in, ready to enter the operating room.
“Wow… The lights are so bright, and the instruments are all lined up so neatly. You do this every day? …Mm, I am a little nervous.”
The surgical team confirms the patient's identity, the procedure, and their respective responsibilities one by one. Aerith listens carefully on the operating table.

“Huh, wait… The surgical site you just mentioned isn't the one you told me about before, is it? Doctor, I can hear you, you know.”

“Am I going to fall asleep now…? Doctor, remember to call my name first when I wake up.”

“My body's starting to feel numb… So this is what it's like to wait for surgery while you're awake. Doctor, tell me before you start, all right?”
“You've given me the local anesthetic already, right? …All right, I'm counting on you. But don't make a sudden incision just because I'm still smiling.”
“Hey, Doctor… We haven't used any anesthetic yet, have we? You're not really planning to operate like this…?”

strings.patient_bundles.patient_aerith.patient.r: “All right, I'll stay. But Doctor, remember to use my name this time. I'm Aerith, not a number.”
“Wait! That isn't what we agreed on, is it? Doctor, this isn't Hojo's laboratory. You need to explain first.”
“I know you're not Hojo... It's just that with so many white coats around me, sometimes I remember the past.”
“No anesthesia? Doctor, are you trying to treat me, or see how long I can stand it? I've seen plenty of that kind of research before.”
“Ah! Doctor, it really hurts! Don't just watch my reactions... I can talk! Listen to me...!”
“Doctor...? When you all suddenly go quiet, I remember my days in the laboratory. Could you say something to me...?”
“It's really over... Thank goodness. This time I'm not somebody's experimental result, just an ordinary patient, right?”
“Huh? You're doing it even though it isn't needed? Doctor, you're acting a little like a certain Shinra researcher... I don't miss him one bit.”
“An enema, too, just to observe a little more? ...I'm joking. But you'd better tell me the real reason.”
“Even my ribbon has to come off... All right. But don't just call me 'the patient' afterward. My name's Aerith.”
“Hiding all my hair... Mm, it feels a little like being at the research facility before. But this time it's just ordinary surgery, right?”
“Wait... You're securing my arms, too? I know this is surgery... But hearing 'don't move' still makes me a little frightened.”
“Doctor, do you know what I hated most back then? Being positioned by someone who then just recorded my reactions... So at least talk to me, all right?”
“W-wait! You're putting it in while I'm completely awake? At least tell me first... Don't just tell me 'don't move'!”
“Ah...! Doctor, I know this is necessary... But it's so uncomfortable... You can hear me talking, can't you?”

strings.patient_bundles.patient_amate_yuzuriha.p: Amate Yuzuriha (Machu)

"They'll restrain me without anesthesia? Don't joke! If it hurts, I can't promise I won't move!"
"My arms and legs can't move now...are you really going to start like this?"

"Hng...! Don't do that suddenly...I know it has to go in, but that feels awful!"
"Brr, that's cold! ...Okay, I won't flinch. Are we nearly ready to start?"
"Once the disinfectant is on, you'll drape me, right? I know, but my heart is still racing."
"So cold...don't tell me the next step is really the scalpel!"
"You all look so practiced...but I'm awake, waiting for the incision. How could I not be scared?!"
"The incision goes here...seeing the line makes this feel too real."
"Don't draw the line and then cut without warning! At least look at me before you start."
"Wait! That's where you'll cut me without anesthesia?!"
"Thinking about the knife coming down here...ha, I don't feel like pretending to be brave anymore."

"You're going to secure me before anesthesia...? I know I shouldn't move, but if it hurts badly, I may not be able to control myself."

"The catheter goes through the urethral opening... Yes, I know its purpose. But please wait; I need a moment to prepare myself."
"Please warn me before you begin. Words I say so calmly in the lab sound completely different when I'm lying here."
"Ah...! Wait... You're inserting the catheter with no anesthesia at all? It really feels uncomfortable... Please go slowly!"
"Ugh... I know this preparation is necessary... but I can feel every touch there... Please tell me what's next!"
"The antiseptic is cold... Yes, I won't move. It's surprising how clearly I can still feel it after anesthesia."
"Is the disinfection area set? Understood. Before the next step, could you check the anesthesia is working once more?"
"...That's cold. Once disinfection is done, you'll cut here with no anesthesia at all, right...?"
"I know the antiseptic itself doesn't hurt... but thinking about the knife touching me soon has my heart racing."
"So this is where the incision will be... I see. Thank you for marking it first. Please confirm the anesthesia is working before you begin."
"The mark is clear. Knowing what to expect doesn't stop me feeling nervous... at least I know where you'll start."
"...This line is where you'll cut without anesthesia in a moment? Doctor, I want to confirm once more..."
"P-please don't bring the knife over yet... I understand what the mark means, but I'm not ready for that pain."

"All right, I'll undress as requested. But Doctor, the instruction is clear—you still haven't explained the examination's scope."
"Your patient explanation makes me feel much safer... I'll cooperate. It's just a little embarrassing."
"...So that's how you give medical instructions. I'll cooperate with necessary examinations, Doctor, but please don't use threats in place of an explanation."

"My surgery is today... Doctor, could you explain the plan once more before preparation begins?"
"Doctor, may I ask for more detail? Once I'm on the table, what will happen—from positioning and disinfection through the incision? I know I'm being rather specific."

At first, Shinobu listened to the medical team with a smile, as if hearing a research briefing. As they explained each step—positioning, disinfection, incision, and what followed—her smile grew strained. She understood every technical term, yet for the first time clearly realized that she herself would soon endure it all.

strings.patient_bundles.patient_iwai_yoshimi.pat: Yoshimi Iwai
"Will I need to be admitted...? I should ask someone to cover my shifts. Oh, sorry—why am I thinking about work again...? Doctor, about how many days would I be staying?"
"All right, I'll be admitted. I'm a nurse too, but this time I'm the patient... Please tell me everything just as you normally would, okay?"
"Huh...? Wait, I don't think that's the procedure you just explained to me. Could you check my chart once more, please?"
"That explanation makes me feel a little better. I used to explain things this way to patients... I didn't expect it to feel so nerve-racking to hear it myself."
"Is that all...? I know everyone is busy, but could you tell me a little more about how we'll begin? Sorry, I can't quite sit still."
"Thank you... I'll do my best to cooperate. I went out of my way not to come to a hospital where people know me, and I'm still blushing from nerves here... I'm sorry."
"General anesthesia... I always tell patients they'll sleep through it and it'll be over. But when I'm the one who's really going to fall asleep... I'm still a little scared."
"With an epidural, I'll stay awake the whole time, right? I know a little about nursing... but the thought of not being able to move my legs still worries me."
"Local anesthesia—I understand. I'll try to stay still, and if I feel discomfort deeper inside, I'll be sure to tell you."
"N-no anesthesia at all?!... I know exactly what you're saying, and that's why I'm even more frightened... Are we really going to operate like this?"
"Thank you... I'll cooperate. Ah, why are my hands still shaking...? I won't cause any trouble once I'm asleep, will I...?"
"Doctor... I know you have to continue, but it really hurts...! I'm sorry—could you please listen to me for a moment...?"
"You're going to secure me already...? I know it's so I won't move, but without anesthesia, I'm afraid I won't be able to hold still when it hurts..."
"Okay, I'll stay still... Ah, I jumped when you steadied me. Sorry—I'll do as you say."
"I really can't lift my legs anymore... Thank you for positioning them for me. I know it's the anesthetic, but I'm still a little panicked."
"...Have you started cutting? It isn't a sharp pain, but that tugging feeling inside... I didn't know I'd feel it so clearly on the operating table..."
"Ah...! The outside doesn't seem to hurt, but that tug inside just now was really unpleasant... Doctor, how far along are you?"
"Aah—!! It hurts! W-wait...! I'm sorry, I can't take it... Doctor, it hurts so much...!"
"D-did you stop...? Thank you... Please give me a moment to catch my breath. I'll try to steady myself again."
"Okay, I won't move... I know this is important, but my body keeps trembling... I'm sorry, I'm not doing it on purpose."
"Mm... You can continue. Please warn me before the next step, and I'll do my best to cooperate."
"Thank you for telling me how far you've gotten... I used to talk patients through things like this. Now I know how much it helps."
"Ah... you're looking at me. Thank you... I thought everyone was so focused on the operation that no one could hear me."
"Um... Doctor? Is something wrong...? I'm not trying to rush you—it's just that everyone suddenly went quiet, and I'm a little scared..."
"It's really almost over...? That's wonderful... Thank you. When I return to work, I'll remember to comfort my patients properly too."
"Okay... breathe slowly. I remember. I've taught this to so many people, but doing it myself is surprisingly difficult..."
"...All right. I won't say anything for now. Knowing you're all still beside me makes me feel much safer..."
"An enema...? I help prepare these on the ward too. But this time I'm the one who has to lie on my side... Could you close the curtain first?"
"I know how to cooperate with this preparation... Um, could I have another moment? Being the one receiving care feels more embarrassing than I expected."
"If an enema isn't needed this time... could we skip it? I'm not refusing to cooperate; I just want to make sure it's really necessary."
"Mm... I know this preparation is sometimes added, but if it isn't required, could you check the order again?"
"The shaving goes this far...? Do you need to shave such a low area too? I understand it's for surgery, but... it's so embarrassing."
"I usually tell patients not to be nervous... but when it's my turn to expose the area that needs shaving, my face still goes bright red."
"This area doesn't need to be shaved, does it...? If it's unnecessary, could we leave it as it is?"
"I'll cooperate with the necessary shaving. But if this part isn't related to the operation, could you check once more?"
"The cap needs to cover my hair and ears... Yes, I know. Ah, a little hair is still loose in the back. I'll tuck it in myself!"
"The cap is on... I put them on patients all the time, but wearing one myself suddenly makes it feel like I'm really being wheeled into the operating room."
"My arm goes here, and my legs need a slight adjustment... I understand. Please tell me before you position me, and I'll cooperate."
"I know this position makes the operation easier... but having so many people adjust my body still makes me uncomfortable. I'm sorry..."
"You're securing my arms and legs before giving me anesthesia...? I know it's so I won't move, but I'm afraid I won't be able to control myself when it hurts..."
"Doctor, if I cry out loudly in a moment, please don't think I'm making trouble on purpose... I'm afraid I really won't be able to help it."
"A urinary catheter... Yes, I know what it's for. But lying here and waiting for someone to insert it... could you warn me first?"
"I've explained this to patients so many times... I never expected to be the one lying here with my legs positioned, waiting for a catheter. I'm so nervous..."
"Ah...! You're placing the catheter before anesthesia...? I'll do my best to cooperate. Please give me a moment to breathe..."
"Ugh... It feels so uncomfortable...! I know it needs to stay in, but being awake makes every sensation so noticeable...!"
"Ah, it's cold... Oh, it's the antiseptic, I know! It was such a sudden chill that I couldn't help flinching..."
"Mm, I won't move. I've had anesthesia, but I can still feel how cold the antiseptic is... That's strange."
"You've started disinfecting... Once you've finished, are you really going to begin cutting...?"
"It's so cold... You haven't even made the incision, and I'm already trembling. Sorry, I'll try not to move..."
"The incision will be marked here... I understand why marking is important. Could you check that the anesthesia is working once more?"
"Seeing that line makes me even more nervous... Doctor, please tell me before you begin, all right?"
"That line... is where you'll cut me in a moment without any anesthesia...? I-I'm really scared..."
"Doctor, the knife hasn't even touched me, and I already want to run... I know I shouldn't move, but I'm so frightened..."

I work as a nurse at another hospital. It's not that I don't trust my coworkers there... It's just so embarrassing to imagine the people I work alongside every day caring for me if I need an examination with my clothes off, an admission, or even surgery. That's why I chose Hoshimi.

"We're not doing this part for now...? Whew, thank you. But please don't skip an examination that's truly necessary just because I'm embarrassed, all right?"
"Y-yes, I'll do as you ask... Um, could you close the curtain before I undress?"
"Thank you for explaining everything first... I'll cooperate. I usually comfort patients myself, but today I'm this nervous..."
"P-please don't speak to me like that... I know necessary examinations have to be done, but that tone makes it even harder for me to know what to do..."

"Doctor... I'm a nurse at another hospital. It's not that I distrust my coworkers, but I don't have the courage to let people who know me care for me like this. Could you tell me today's plan first?"

"Um, could I ask for more detail? I usually help with preoperative preparation, but that was always for someone else... Once I'm on the table, what order will things happen in—from positioning and disinfection to the incision?"

At first, Yoshimi nodded out of habit, as though listening to a routine nursing handoff on the ward. The more the staff explained the exposure, positioning, disinfection, incision, and subsequent steps awaiting her, the harder it became to think of them as ordinary work. Realizing that she would be the one on the operating table receiving this care, she quietly gripped the blanket and blushed too deeply to look up.

strings.patient_bundles.patient_miyamizu_mitsuha: Mitsuha Miyamizu
“I need to be admitted…? I just sent out a few résumés and have interviews scheduled. I don't mean work matters more than my health! I just want to know roughly how long I'll be staying.”
“All right, I'll be admitted. I can take care of things in Tokyo myself… but this is my first time dealing with something like this, so I'll need your guidance, Doctor.”
“Huh? Wait, wasn't that a different operation from the one we discussed? Did I hear wrong?… Could we check my chart first?”
“Okay, now I understand! Knowing what comes next makes me feel less nervous… Thank you.”
“Is that all? I'm not trying to be difficult, but please at least tell me how you'll prepare me. Otherwise I'll keep imagining all sorts of things.”
“All right, I understand. I'll cooperate with the preparations… I may sound calm, but my heart is still racing.”
“General anesthesia… So the operation will be over when I wake up, right? Okay… I'll leave everything to you.”
“With an epidural, I'll stay awake but won't be able to move my legs like usual…? Just imagining it scares me a little.”
“Local anesthesia, okay. If I feel uncomfortable anywhere, I can tell you right away, right? I'll try not to move.”
“W-wait, no anesthesia at all?! I know I shouldn't panic, but it really will hurt, won't it? Could you explain it to me again?”
“Mm, I'm ready… probably. Ah, my hands are still shaking… Doctor, please take care of everything while I'm asleep.”
“Ah… It hurts, it hurts! Wait, it really hurts! I've been trying so hard to stay still… Doctor, please listen to me!”
“You're going to secure me first…? So I won't move when it hurts. I understand why, but thinking about it makes me even more scared…”
“Okay, my arm goes here, right? I won't move… Ah, please tell me before touching me suddenly!”
“I really can't move my legs… I know it's the anesthesia, but I still feel a little panicky. Thank you for helping me adjust.”
“…You've already made the incision? It isn't the sharp pain I imagined, but I can feel the deep pressure and pulling… I didn't expect to feel so much…”
“Ah…! W-wait, the skin doesn't hurt that much, but that deeper sensation just now… Doctor, is this really normal?”
“Aah!! It hurts! Doctor, wait…! You're really cutting now… I can't, I can't take it…!”
“…You stopped? Haa… thank you. I need a moment to catch my breath. I was so startled that I couldn't breathe properly.”
“I know I have to stay still… I'll try! But my body is shaking on its own. Please don't startle me suddenly.”
“…Okay, you can continue. If the next step will feel noticeable, could you warn me first?”
“Thank you for keeping me updated… I can hear you. Knowing what everyone is doing keeps me from staring at the ceiling and imagining things.”
“Ah… Doctor. You're still listening to me, right?… Mm, that makes me feel a little safer.”
“Doctor…? Why did everyone suddenly go quiet? You're just busy, right…? Please say something back to me.”
“It's really almost over?… Thank goodness. I thought I wouldn't be able to keep going… Thank you, everyone.”
“Okay, breathe in slowly, then out… Mm, I'll do that. The way you explain things makes me feel less nervous.”
“…Okay. I'll be quiet for a little while… Just knowing you're still here beside me helps so much.”
“An enema… in the ward too? O-okay… Could you close the curtain first? I'm a little embarrassed.”
“I need to lie on my side for the preparation? Okay, I'll cooperate… I've been so nervous I don't know what to do with my hands.”
“Huh, do I need an enema this time too? If it isn't related to the operation, could we double-check?”
“If this preparation isn't necessary… could I skip it? I'm not trying to get out of it; I just want to understand why.”
“You have to shave the hair here…? Ah, that's a bigger area than I expected! I know it's for the operation, but I'm still embarrassed.”
“W-wait, don't pull the blanket back so quickly! Tell me what needs to be uncovered and I'll cooperate…”
“Do I need to shave here too? If it's outside the area needed for surgery, could you ask the doctor again?”
“I'll cooperate with any necessary preparation… but if this part doesn't need treatment, could we leave it as it is?”
“All my hair has to go under the cap, even around my ears…? Okay, I'll tuck the ends in at the back too.”
“Once I put on the surgical cap… it suddenly feels like I'm really going to the operating room. I'll tuck my hair away so I don't cause trouble.”
“My hands go here, and keep my shoulders still… Okay, I'll do that. I'm just nervous with so many people adjusting my position at once.”
“Ah, once I'm positioned like this, I can't move by myself, right? I know it's for surgery… but I'd like to see what you're going to do first.”
“You're securing me before surgery even without anesthesia…? I understand you don't want me to move, but I don't know if I can control myself when it hurts…”
“I can't change this position easily now… Doctor, if I can't take it, please promise you'll listen to me, okay?”
“I need a urinary catheter too…? Ah, I understand. I'll cooperate, but… could you give me a moment to get ready?”
“It goes in there…? Mm, I know it's a medical procedure. I just feel a little awkward with other people standing nearby…”
“Wait, you're placing a catheter before I've been anesthetized…? I-I'll try to stay still; please warn me first!”
“Ah…! That feels strange… no, really uncomfortable! I'm still awake—could you tell me what comes next more slowly?”
“Ah, that's cold!… Oh, it's the antiseptic. Even after anesthesia, I can still feel how cold it is.”
“Mm, I won't move… It was just so cold when you wiped it on that I jumped. Sorry.”
“You're starting the antiseptic… so the incision really is next, isn't it? I know we agreed, but my heart won't stop racing…”
“It's so cold… and I haven't had any anesthesia. Doctor, please tell me before you actually begin.”
“You're marking the incision here… Seeing that line suddenly makes the operation feel real.”
“I know marking it is necessary… I just want to confirm that you've checked the anesthesia is working, right?”
“That line… is where you'll cut even though I won't have anesthesia?… I suddenly want to close my eyes.”
“Doctor, you're really going to cut along that line…? L-let me breathe for a moment. I'm shaking with nerves…”
Doctor, I came in today because: {line}… I've been busy looking for work, so suddenly feeling unwell has left me a little unsure what to do.
Mm, the main thing I've noticed is: {line}. I'll do my best to explain what happened.
There's one more thing I'd like to mention: {line}. Could it be related to the discomfort I mentioned earlier?

I moved to Tokyo from a small mountain town in Gifu. My family used to care for a shrine, and I can make traditional braided cords too. I just graduated from university and am applying for jobs and preparing for interviews. Tokyo has always been the place I wanted to be… but living here on my own means I still have to learn how to handle things one at a time.
Mitsuha Miyamizu's Medical Record
“Huh, I have to take all my clothes off for the examination…? I know you need to examine my body, Doctor, but I'm still embarrassed. Could you tell me which areas you'll examine first?”
“We don't need to do that part for now…? Phew, that's a relief. But if it really is necessary, please tell me again, okay?”
“O-okay, I'll cooperate… but you startled me by bringing it up so suddenly. Could I close the curtain first?”
“Thank you for explaining first… Okay, I understand. I'll cooperate; it's just embarrassing when it's me.”
“Wait… there's no need to put it that way, is there? If the examination is necessary, I'll cooperate. But please at least tell me why.”
Mitsuha Miyamizu · Preoperative Preparation and Surgery
“Doctor, my operation is today, right…? I know it's all arranged, but before the preparations begin, could you tell me what will happen next?”

“Could I ask for a little more detail? Once we reach the operating room, in what order will you position me, disinfect the area, and make the incision?… I'm afraid I'll get so nervous that I won't know what's coming next.”

At first Mitsuha listened closely, nodding gently as the staff explained each step. They described the preparations, securing her position, disinfection, incision, and retraction in the calm tone of someone reviewing an ordinary checklist. Gradually, Mitsuha realized that every item on that list would happen to her soon. She stopped nodding and quietly gripped the blanket, forgetting even the question she had prepared.

“Wow… those lights are bright. I know I shouldn't look around or move… Doctor, could you call my name before you really begin?”

“You're starting the general anesthesia… Okay. I hope the operation will be over by the time I wake up.… I'm counting on you.”

“An epidural means I'll stay conscious but won't be able to move freely… I understand, but just imagining it makes me a little anxious.”
“Local anesthesia, right? I'll try to stay still. If the pulling inside feels unpleasant, I'll tell you right away—just don't make me try to endure it in silence.”
“Wait… You're going to operate without any anesthesia? Doctor, it's not that I refuse treatment, but everything about this sounds frightening!”
“Okay… I've taken care of everything I needed to. Doctor, I'll leave the rest to you. …Funny, usually I'm the one telling everyone else not to worry. Today I can't seem to let go myself.”
“Ah… It hurts! N-no, I can't take that…! I know you're still operating, but could you please listen to me for a moment?”

“Doctor… you're still looking at me. Mm, I'm all right… No, I'm still a little scared. Thank you for not only focusing on the operation.”

“I don't need skin prep? Wow, what a relief. But please don't skip anything necessary just because I'm embarrassed.”
“No hair removal today? OK! I didn't realize surgical preparations could vary so much. I was imagining all sorts of things.”

“The cap has to fit this snugly... I'm usually quick at changing outfits, but dressed as a patient today, I'm still not used to it.”
“Arms over here, and don't turn your body... OK, I understand. It's just nerve-racking with the lights shining and so many people around.”
“Doctor, how long do I need to stay in this position? I can cooperate, but lying here unable to adjust myself takes more patience than playing guitar.”
“W-wait... without any anesthesia, I have to hold this position the whole time? I'm afraid I'll curl up when it hurts!”
“You need to secure me so I won't suddenly move... I understand why, but thinking about surgery while I'm awake makes my legs start shaking...”
“A urinary catheter... I know it may be needed during surgery. But I'm still awake. Could you tell me when you're going to start? This is so embarrassing...”
“This step has to be done on the operating table too...? I'll try not to move, but I'll speak up if it feels uncomfortable.”
“No anesthesia at all, and I still need a urinary catheter...? Wait, I'll be so nervous I might move. Please explain everything first!”
“Ah... I know it's necessary, but being awake for it is embarrassing and I'm afraid it'll hurt... Please don't start without warning me.”

“The antiseptic feels cold... and smells so much like a hospital. Um, after this, are you preparing the incision?”

“Do I need to be admitted...? I know I shouldn't put off taking care of my health. It's just a little sudden... Doctor, what should I prepare first?”
“All right, I'll stay in the hospital. In the past, when I faced something frightening, I thought about running away... but this time I'll accept treatment properly.”
“Please wait. That isn't the operation we just confirmed, is it...? I don't mean to cause trouble, but we need to make sure.”
“I see... Thank you for explaining everything. Knowing what will happen next helps me feel a little calmer.”
“You're only saying you'll follow the usual steps...? I'm sorry, but I'd still like to know a little more. I'm the one who'll be lying on the operating table, after all.”
“Mm... I trust you. I'll do my best to cooperate, though my palms are still sweating...”
“General anesthesia... Once I'm asleep, I'll have to put myself completely in your hands, won't I? Please be sure to tell me the surgery is over when I wake up.”
“I'll still be conscious, but part of my body won't move... That sounds so strange. Please call my name before you begin.”
“Local anesthesia...? Then I'll try to stay still. If I still feel pain inside, can I tell you right away?”
“No anesthesia at all...? I once picked up a sword and faced danger, but that's nothing like being cut while conscious... Doctor, do we really have to do this?”
“All right... I'll close my eyes. I'll leave the rest to you. When I wake up... please tell me then.”
“Ah... Doctor, wait! I'm really trying to bear it, but it hurts too much...! Please listen to me—stop for a moment!”
“I know I mustn't move... but thinking about the pain coming soon makes my body stop listening to me. Please tell me how to cooperate first...”
“Mm, I'll try not to move... That last touch inside was a little uncomfortable. Could you warn me before continuing?”
“I know this is how it feels after anesthesia... but being positioned like this and unable to move still frightens me a little.”
“...You've already made the incision? It isn't a sharp pain, but it feels like something was pushed deep inside... Doctor, could you keep telling me what's happening?”
“Tss...! The surface doesn't hurt much, but I clearly felt something deep inside just now... Doctor, could you check?”
“Aah—!! It hurts! W-wait... You really made the incision! Doctor, please stop... I can't take it!”
“...Have you stopped? Thank you... Let me catch my breath. I'll try to calm down...”
“All right, I won't move... Please give me the instructions slowly. I'll listen carefully.”
“...Mm, you can continue. I'm still afraid, but I'll tell you clearly what's uncomfortable.”
“Thank you for telling me what's happening... Hearing your voices keeps me from thinking only about frightening things.”
“...Doctor? Yes, I can see you. I'm still awake, and I can hear you... I'll tell you if anything feels wrong.”
“Doctor...? Why did everyone suddenly go quiet...? Is the operation going well? Could you answer me, please?”
“It's really almost over...? That's wonderful... I thought I wouldn't be able to hold on until now.”
“All right... I'll breathe along with your voice... I can hold on a little longer. Please tell me when it's over.”
“...Thank you. When it's truly over, could you tell me one more time...?”
“I need an enema before surgery...? I understand it's for the operation, but... I'm a little embarrassed by this preparation.”
“Should I turn onto my side...? All right, I'll do that. Please just tell me what comes next so I won't be startled.”
“No enema this time...? Whew... that's a relief. It's not that I don't want to cooperate; just thinking about it makes me nervous.”
“I don't need that done...? Thank you for telling me. Is there anything else I need to prepare for? I'd like to know first.”
“Skin preparation... Does that mean shaving the hair in the surgical area? I understand it's necessary, but having someone else do it is still embarrassing...”
“Um... Does it need to be done in such a private area? All right, I'll cooperate, but please explain the area first...”
“No skin preparation this time...? I'm relieved. But if it's really necessary, you don't have to worry about my embarrassment.”
“You don't need to remove any hair...? So it's not the same for every operation. I was imagining all sorts of frightening preparations.”
“I need to tuck all my hair into this cap...? All right, I'll put it on. My ears need to be covered too, right?”
“Once I put on the surgical cap, I suddenly feel like a real patient... It's only a cap, but my heart is beating faster.”
“My hands go here, and my body faces this way... Mm, I understand. Could you tell me how long I need to stay like this?”
“I can't easily change position while lying like this...? All right, I'll cooperate. I'm just a little nervous with so many people around.”
“No anesthesia at all... Once I'm positioned, I'll have to undergo surgery while conscious...? I'm afraid I'll flinch and try to get away when it hurts.”
“I know you're worried I'll move, but thinking about the pain makes me even more nervous... Please don't start suddenly, all right?”
“A urinary catheter...? Mm, I know it may be needed during surgery. But I'm still awake... Could you tell me when you'll begin?”
“I have to let someone help me with something so private... It's really embarrassing. I'll try not to move, and I'll speak up if I'm uncomfortable.”
“A catheter with no anesthesia at all...? Wait, I know I need to cooperate, but I'm so nervous I can hardly breathe...”
“Please tell me what it will feel like first... This is embarrassing enough while I'm conscious, and I'm afraid it will hurt...”
“Ah, that's cold...! Sorry, the disinfectant startled me. I'll lie still.”
“The area being disinfected is so large... Mm, I can feel it. Are you getting ready to make the incision next?”
“So cold... Once the disinfection is done, you'll start without anesthesia, right? I know what's next, but I still want to back away...”
“I can feel the disinfectant... and I know the blade won't disappear just because I'm afraid. Doctor, please tell me before you begin...”
“Is this where the incision will go...? I see. So you'll really mark my body first.”
“Doctor, this line marks where the operation will begin, right...? Mm, I can see it. It's much more frightening than just hearing about it...”
“W-wait... This line marks where you'll cut without anesthesia? Can I really see it this clearly...?”
“You've marked it already... I used to be able to grip my sword when facing danger, but now I can only lie here and watch... Doctor, I'm so scared.”
Hello, Doctor... I was going to wait and see, but my condition has changed like this: {line}
The most noticeable discomfort is: {line} I'm afraid I won't explain it clearly. Could you check with me again?
There's one more thing I'd like to tell you: {line} ...Should we record these together?

I live an ordinary life now. I once faced some very dangerous situations to protect people important to me... but this time my health is the problem, and I don't want to solve it by simply forcing myself through it.
strings.patient_bundles.patient_yuko_asou.encoun: “Do I need to take off all my clothes for the examination...? I know it's for diagnosis, b-but hearing it so suddenly is embarrassing... Could you tell me what you'll examine first?”
“We're not doing this part for now...? Whew... thank you. But have you really checked everything that needs to be checked?”
“...All right, I'll cooperate. P-please close the curtain first... I just need a little time to get ready.”
“Thank you for explaining it slowly... Mm, I feel calmer now. I'll do it, though I'm blushing a little...”
“...Please don't say that. I know I need the examination, but rushing me like that only makes me more afraid... I'll cooperate, so please explain it properly.”
Yuko Asou's Preoperative Preparation
“Doctor, the surgery is today, right...? I know I agreed, but now that it's here, I'm still a little scared. Could you tell me what will happen?”

“I'd like to understand a little more... Once I'm on the operating table, how will you position me and prepare my body? When will you disinfect the area and make the incision? If I'm still awake, how much will I know...?”

Yuko listens quietly at first, as if trying to remember every step the medical staff describe. They calmly explain the positioning, preparation, disinfection, incision, and what follows. Only then does she realize that this is not danger she can face with a sword in hand, but a series of procedures she will have to lie still and undergo. Her hard-won composure begins to fade, and she grips the blanket more tightly.

The operation continues. If Yuko Asou remains conscious, she tends to grow quiet and seek reassurance when tense, embarrassed, or afraid. After understanding the situation, she gathers her courage and tries to cooperate.
